utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Dane, have you heard about the repair drive happening this Saturday? I'm thinking of checking it out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, the repair drive? I just got here, haven't heard much yet. Sounds cool though, count me in!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great! I think it's at the community center, maybe we can go together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I'm so glad we're all on the same page—Saturday will be perfect for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, Mara, and I've got Sam marking the drop-off spots on the map. Should I add your place as a collection point too?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Opal! My garage has plenty of space—I’ll clear it out Friday so we can start collecting donations first thing Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: How about I just bring a selection over to your place this weekend? That way you can pick what you need on the spot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, uh, that sounds great, Gus. This weekend? Yeah, I think I'm free... maybe. Just, uh, remind me again Friday, alright?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Noah. I'll give you a nudge on Friday. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh hey, Vik! The repair drive... wait, was that today or tomorrow? I always mix those up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Tomorrow, Oren! Starts at 10 AM sharp at the community center—Maria told me.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Tomorrow, right, right. I'll put a note on my fridge this time so I don't forget again.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Kira, I'm sorting through supplies for the repair drive on Saturday — need any help?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, repair drive on Saturday? I'm not even sure who's organizing it—are you sure you've got the right person?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, it's definitely happening—Rosa and I have been planning it. I figured you might know someone with tools to lend!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira! We're having a repair drive for the playground this Saturday—want to join us? I've already got a bunch of folks lined up!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Wait, I thought the repair drive was for the community center roof, not the playground. Are we doing both?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh no, it's definitely the playground equipment! We're fixing the swings and slide—someone must've mixed up dates. Want to help out?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Pia, I'm collecting broken tools for the repair drive on Saturday. Got anything that needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I do have a broken blender, but I'm worried—do you all have enough spare parts to fix everything?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, we've got a good stash of common parts. Bring it by and I'll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana! I was just thinking about the repair drive we're organizing—do you have any items that need fixing?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I do have a few things, but before we get into that, have you had a chance to check the error log? I'd like to review it together first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure, let's check the error log now. I think it's in the shared folder.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Rey, it's so good to see you! I was hoping you might have some time to lend a hand with the repair drive Saturday—we could really use your energy.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'd love to help, Rosa. What time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, that's wonderful! We're starting at 9 AM, and I think you'd be perfect helping with setup and greeting folks as they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I'm sure they'll manage—they've got a bunch of volunteers lined up and I heard someone even donated a pile of spare parts last week!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That's good to hear. Maybe I can put some of those parts to use on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You should definitely come by! I heard they're also looking for people to help with the repairs, not just drop-offs.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Eli, do you have the exact time for the repair drive this Saturday? I'm trying to get it straight.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Mina, I've penciled it in for 9 AM sharp. We'll start with a quick briefing to pair up jobs with tools.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, 9 AM works for me. Who's bringing the power drills?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, yeah, I only caught a bit in the group chat—think it's Saturday, but you'd better double-check.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Saturday sounds right, but I'll check with Opal to be sure—she's the one running it, and I'm helping her map out the drop-off spots.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Cool, yeah, you're on top of it. I'll probably just swing by with my toaster and see what happens.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Kira! Perfect timing—I was just about to knock on your door. We're fixing up the playground equipment this Saturday, and I need your infectious energy there!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure you've got the right person? I thought there was some mix-up about who's organizing this thing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No mix-up at all! Mara and I are co-organizing, and I know you'd be a huge help—plus, everyone loves when you're around.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Vik, I was just talking to Mina about the repair drive—she really wants to get it going. Have you heard anything?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh yeah, Ira! It's tomorrow at 10 AM at the community center—I already told the folks on Birch Street about it. Cleo's got the tools ready and Oren's putting a note on his fridge so he won't forget.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks Vik! I'll let Mina know it's all set—she'll be relieved to hear the details are nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, Rey. Are you planning to join the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good morning, Eli. I'm still trying to find out the details—do you know when it starts?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I've got the schedule right here. We're kicking off at 9 AM sharp on Saturday, with a full list of jobs and tool assignments ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: The repair drive, right? Did you get a chance to look at the error log before we start?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, I haven't checked the error log yet—honestly, I've been juggling the kids' schedules all morning. But I'm happy to look it over once I get a free minute!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries at all—let's pull it up together now, that way we're both on the same page before we touch anything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I'm trying to figure out the details so I can help out. Does Saturday work for you?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday sounds right to me—I'm just gonna drop by with my toaster quick.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, a toaster too! I've got a wobbly chair and a broken toaster, so I'm glad I'm not the only one bringing small stuff.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane, you heard about the repair drive? We could use a hand!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I just got here, actually—what's the situation? Happy to help once I'm caught up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing, Dane! We're organizing a neighborhood repair drive to fix up broken stuff—tools, appliances, furniture. I'm helping coordinate, and we could really use your skills if you're handy!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive—right, I think Leo mentioned it. I was gonna check my garage, but then I got sidetracked by that rusty wrench...

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just hope they’ve got enough spare parts for everyone—it’d be a shame if someone brought something in and had to take it back unfixed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Good point, Pia. I should probably actually look for that wrench now before I forget again.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Leo, glad you're interested! Do you have any tools you could donate or lend for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got a few screwdrivers and a hammer I can bring. They're in decent shape.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, those will be useful! Could you drop them off at Marcus's garage on Saturday—he's our main collection spot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll bring some tools from my shed, might have a few things that'll come in handy.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Uli! That'll be a big help. I'll make sure we have a spot to sort everything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No problem, happy to pitch in where I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Mina! Did you hear about the repair drive this weekend? They're fixing appliances for free—I saw the sign-up sheet at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, I saw that too. But I'm trying to pin down the exact start time—do you know if it's 9 AM or later?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think it's 9 AM, but let me double-check—I can swing by the community center later and grab a flyer for you!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, Vik just said it's tomorrow at 10 AM at the community center—I better write that down before it slips my mind again.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, good, so you've got the time. I'll bring the supply list I've been working on so we can match folks with what they need.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, a supply list—that's a great idea. I'll try to remember to bring my toolbox this time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, I heard about the repair drive. I've got a bunch of tools in my shed if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Gus, that's great! We could always use more tools. Are you free Friday evening to help sort everything out?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Friday evening works for me! I'll bring my toolbox so we can see what all we've got to work with.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
